projects.name: as a Business Aanlyst
details: Fund Services UAT Testing (Instructions Capture):
Requirement  gathering,  BRD/FRD  creation, JIRA and functional analysis for fund services platforms
Extensive Functional  & UAT testing experience across instruction  capture, financial  reporting,  and accounting  systems
Defect management,  test case creation (SWIFT, accounting  flows), and sign-off coordination.
Successfully  onboarded  the NYILM Project and identified  critical defects across instruction  capture applications.
Created 200+ SWIFT test cases and proactively resolved issues with IC Operations leads and the VET team. Harvested
SWIFT messages according to client requirements  for smooth trade flow in the Fund accounting  platform Product types
of FI, Equity, ETD future and option, TBA and MBS.
Liaised with stakeholders  to resolve sub-advisor requirements  for suitable formats.
Reviewed all swift trades once they were STP in WINS (Accounting  platform).
Data Ǫuality  Management  and Data Governace  :
Facilitated and supported  Regulatory Reporting and Data Ǫuality initiatives across Financial Markets and Coverage
business lines, ensuring accurate and timely submissions of reports to global regulators.
Performed detailed business analysis and gap assessments to identify compliance breaches, data quality issues, and
control deficiencies across trade, position, and reference data domains.
Leveraged in-depth knowledge of the End-to-End Trade Lifecycle (Front-to-Back) including trade capture, confirmation,
clearing, settlement, and reporting to ensure regulatory alignment.
Led metadata management initiatives, documenting data lineage, data dictionaries, control frameworks, and data
ownership models to enhance transparency and audit readiness.
Initiated a data quality management operating model to streamline firmwide regulatory reporting and analysis in
AXIOM/CAPRI.
Discussed  upstream complex feed and production  issues with stakeholders  and collaborated  with cross-functional  teams.
Interacted with technology  partners to address data quality issues registered  in the DǪM portal.
Operational changes requirement & business requirement document were shared to strategy team to understand the root
cause & create a JIRA, Summit, and DǪM accordingly for resolution.
Prepared senior  management decks and regulatory  governance updates summarizing data  quality metrics, risk  exposure,
remediation progress, and compliance posture.
Artemis Decommission (IRECS)
The system should automatically  reconcile  transaction  records between source and target systems and flag mismatches.
Performed  gap analysis between legacy systems and target platforms, identifying  improvement  opportunities.
Onboarded  IRECS reconciliation  for OTC Valuation,  OTC Position, and OTC Cash& replicated  the same logic and
calculations using
BRD, Tech Dump, and Artemis application  for multiple clients.
Focused on comparing the output to  Artemis recs and analysing discrepancy, highlighting key issues prior  to operational
Go live
Identified and investigated  issues (ARTEMIS  between IRECS) and highlighted  necessary changes to product development
owners.
Liaised with Stakeholders  and technology  teams for project-related queries and requirement  changes.
Prepared Test Scenarios  and Test Cases aligned with business flows & Supported  UAT planning and execution  with
business user.
State Street HCL Services Ltd., Coimbatore, Specialist – Client Onboarding &
Reference Data Management |
